mentions.name: security-check
mentions.description: This open source CLI tool audits macOS security settings. It scans around 40 settings (FileVault, Firewall, Gatekeeper, SIP, etc.), assigns a letter grade, and can output JSON for piping into other tools. A --diff flag tracks what changed between runs, it runs in under 5 seconds, has zero dependencies, and ships as a single binary.
mentions.problem: The author couldn't find a simple, maintained CLI tool to check how well their own Mac's security settings were configured: Lynis felt too enterprise-heavy, mSCP is designed for fleet management, and GUI tools don't fit a developer workflow.
mentions.audience: The tool is built to fit into a developer workflow, addressing the gap that existing macOS security tools are either enterprise-heavy, fleet-management oriented, or GUI-only.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building security-check(https://github.com/idlework/security-check), a fast and open source CLI tool to audit your macOS security settings.
